text: Table: customers. Column: customerNumber. Description: Unique customer ID. Primary Key. Role: pk. Synonyms: client id, account id, customer code.
Table: customers. Column: customerName. Description: Customer/company legal or trading name. Role: dimension. Synonyms: client name, company name, purchaser.
Table: customers. Column: contactLastName. Description: Last name of the primary contact. Role: dimension. Synonyms: surname, contact person last name.
Table: customers. Column: contactFirstName. Description: First name of the primary contact. Role: dimension. Synonyms: given name, contact person first name.
Table: customers. Column: phone. Description: Primary contact phone (stored as text). Role: contact. Synonyms: contact number, mobile, telephone.
Table: customers. Column: addressLine1. Description: Street address line 1. Role: address. Synonyms: street address, primary address.
Table: customers. Column: addressLine2. Description: Street address line 2 (optional). Role: address. Synonyms: suite, floor, unit.
Table: customers. Column: city. Description: Customer city. Role: geo. Synonyms: municipality, town.
Table: customers. Column: state. Description: State/province/region (optional). Role: geo. Synonyms: region, province.
Table: customers. Column: postalCode. Description: Postal/ZIP code (may include leading zeros). Role: geo. Synonyms: zip code, post code.
Table: customers. Column: country. Description: Customer country. Role: geo. Synonyms: nation.

Table: customers. Column: salesRepEmployeeNumber. Description: Account manager employee number. FK to employees.employeeNumber. Role: fk. Synonyms: account manager id, sales rep id, assigned sales person.
Table: customers. Column: creditLimit. Description: Approved credit limit for this customer. Role: measure. Synonyms: credit ceiling, max credit, spending limit.
Table: employees. Column: employeeNumber. Description: Unique employee ID. Primary Key. Role: pk. Synonyms: staff id, worker id.
Table: employees. Column: lastName. Description: Employee surname/family name. Role: dimension. Synonyms: surname.
Table: employees. Column: firstName. Description: Employee given/first name. Role: dimension. Synonyms: given name.
Table: employees. Column: extension. Description: Internal phone extension. Role: contact. Synonyms: internal phone, ext.
Table: employees. Column: email. Description: Work email address. Role: contact. Synonyms: work email, contact email.
Table: employees. Column: officeCode. Description: Assigned office. FK to offices.officeCode. Role: fk. Synonyms: office id, location code. Example value: 1.

Table: employees. Column: reportsTo. Description: Direct manager employeeNumber; FK to employees.employeeNumber. NULL if top-level. Role: fk. Synonyms: manager id, supervisor id, direct report. Example value: 1002.
Table: employees. Column: jobTitle. Description: Official job title or role. Role: dimension. Synonyms: position, designation, role. Example value: President.
Table: offices. Column: officeCode. Description: Unique office code. Primary Key. Role: pk. Synonyms: office id, branch code. Example value: 1.
Table: offices. Column: city. Description: City where the office is located. Role: geo. Synonyms: office city, branch location. Example value: San Francisco.
Table: offices. Column: phone. Description: Main office phone (stored as text). Role: contact. Synonyms: office phone. Example value: +1 650 219 4782.
Table: offices. Column: addressLine1. Description: Street address line 1. Role: address. Synonyms: street. Example value: 100 Market Street.
Table: offices. Column: addressLine2. Description: Street address line 2 (suite/floor; optional). Role: address. Synonyms: suite. Example value: Suite 300.
Table: offices. Column: state. Description: State/province/region (optional). Role: geo. Synonyms: region. Example value: CA.
Table: offices. Column: country. Description: Country where the office is located. Role: geo. Synonyms: nation. Example value: USA.
Table: offices. Column: postalCode. Description: Postal/ZIP code (keep text to preserve leading zeros). Role: geo. Synonyms: zip. Example value: 94080.
Table: offices. Column: territory. Description: Sales region/territory code (e.g., NA, EMEA, APAC). Role: dimension. Synonyms: sales region, area. Example value: NA.
Table: orderdetails. Column: orderNumber. Description: Order ID. FK to orders.orderNumber. Part of composite PK. Role: fk. Synonyms: order id, transaction id.
Table: orderdetails. Column: productCode. Description: Product code. FK to products.productCode. Part of composite PK. Role: fk. Synonyms: sku, item code.
Table: orderdetails. Column: quantityOrdered. Description: Units ordered on this line item. Role: measure. Synonyms: qty, count, units, volume.
Table: orderdetails. Column: priceEach. Description: Unit selling price at order time. Role: measure. Synonyms: unit price, selling price, deal price.
Table: orderdetails. Column: orderLineNumber. Description: Line sequence number within the order (1..n). Role: dimension. Synonyms: line sequence, item number.
Table: orders. Column: orderNumber. Description: Unique order ID. Primary Key. Role: pk. Synonyms: order id, invoice id.
Table: orders. Column: orderDate. Description: Date the order was created. Role: date. Synonyms: purchase date, transaction date.
Table: orders. Column: requiredDate. Description: Requested ship-by/fulfillment deadline. Role: date. Synonyms: due date, deadline.
Table: orders. Column: shippedDate. Description: Actual ship date; NULL if not yet shipped. Role: date. Synonyms: delivery date, dispatch date.

Table: orders. Column: status. Description: Order status (e.g., Shipped, In Process, On Hold, Cancelled, Disputed, Resolved). Role: dimension. Synonyms: order state, condition. Example value: Shipped.
Table: orders. Column: comments. Description: Free-form order notes (optional). Role: text. Synonyms: notes, instructions.
Table: orders. Column: customerNumber. Description: Ordering customer. FK to customers.customerNumber. Role: fk. Synonyms: buyer id, purchaser id.
Table: payments. Column: customerNumber. Description: Paying customer. FK to customers.customerNumber. Role: fk. Synonyms: payer id.
Table: payments. Column: checkNumber. Description: Payment reference. Part of composite PK with customerNumber. Role: pk. Synonyms: payment reference, transaction ref.
Table: payments. Column: paymentDate. Description: Date the payment was recorded. Role: date. Synonyms: transaction date.
Table: payments. Column: amount. Description: Payment amount in billing currency. Role: measure. Synonyms: payment value, total paid, money received.
Table: productlines. Column: productLine. Description: Product line or category name. Primary Key. Role: pk. Synonyms: category, product family. Example value: Classic Cars.
Table: productlines. Column: textDescription. Description: Plain text description (optional). Role: text. Synonyms: description, details.

stats.sample_value: Attention car enthusiasts: Make your wildest car ownership dreams come true. Whether you are looking for classic muscle cars, dream sports cars or movie-inspired miniatures, you will find great choices in this category. These replicas feature superb attention to detail and craftsmanship and offer features such as working steering system, opening forward compartment, opening rear trunk with removable spare wheel, 4-wheel independent spring suspension, and so on. The models range in size from 1:10 to 1:24 scale and include numerous limited edition and several out-of-production vehicles. All models include a certificate of authenticity from their manufacturers and come fully assembled and ready for display in the home or office.

text: Table: productlines. Column: htmlDescription. Description: HTML description for web display (optional). Role: text. Synonyms: html content.
Table: productlines. Column: image. Description: Image or logo (BLOB; optional). Role: binary. Synonyms: picture, photo.
Table: products. Column: productCode. Description: Unique product code. Primary Key. Role: pk. Synonyms: sku, item id.
Table: products. Column: productName. Description: Human-readable product name. Role: dimension. Synonyms: item name, model name.
Table: products. Column: productLine. Description: Owning product line. FK to productlines.productLine. Role: fk. Synonyms: category, family. Example value: Motorcycles.
Table: products. Column: productScale. Description: Model scale ratio text (e.g., 1:10, 1:18). Role: dimension. Synonyms: model scale, ratio. Example value: 1:10.
Table: products. Column: productVendor. Description: Manufacturer or vendor name. Role: dimension. Synonyms: manufacturer, brand, maker.
Table: products. Column: productDescription. Description: Plain-text description of features and details. Role: text. Synonyms: specs, details.

stats.sample_value: This replica features working kickstand, front suspension, gear-shift lever, footbrake lever, drive chain, wheels and steering. All parts are particularly delicate due to their precise scale and require special care and attention.

text: Table: products. Column: quantityInStock. Description: Current on-hand inventory (units). Role: measure. Synonyms: inventory, stock level, available units.
Table: products. Column: buyPrice. Description: Unit purchase cost. Role: measure. Synonyms: cost, cogs, purchase price.
Table: products. Column: MSRP. Description: Manufacturer's suggested retail price. Role: measure. Synonyms: retail price, list price, catalog price.
